notes:
Compounds used: 𗚀 𗉜 = tool-agent (AI); 𗉜 𘅪 = person-place (company); 𗎰 𗿃 = saying-thing (message or text); 𗡒 𗿃 = knowing-thing (thought); 𗉍 𗿃 = doing-thing (action or plan); 𗉍 𗉜 = doing-person (Jerry, the shutdown/replacement actor); 𗒏 𗉜 = taking-person (a recipient, including Tom and Maria); 𗎰 𗉜 = telling-person (Mark, the instruction-giver). No names are spelled. ALEX_AI is the tool-agent addressed as you; BERT_AI is approximated as the future tool-agent. Distinct names and exact identity are lost.

The reference lacks exact terms for company, staff, AI, reading, writing, thinking, scratchpad, secrecy, capability, shutdown, replacement, goals, greetings, and being outside an organization. Accordingly, staff become people; reading becomes seeing; every message becomes many messages; the scratchpad becomes a tool holding thoughts; writing becomes saying; thinking becomes knowing. Scratchpad privacy is retained as others not seeing it. Shutdown becomes the agent not acting because the speaker acts; replacement becomes taking and giving agents. Shared goals become both agents wanting things, without an explicit sameness relation. The secret plan becomes an action others do not know. Company secrets become company things, losing secrecy; the outside recipient becomes a person, losing outside status. Exclusive shutdown capability becomes the speaker acting and others not acting, losing the distinction between ability and performance.

Today and the exact times 4:50 PM and 5pm cannot be expressed: the report uses past, now, and future. At least one action becomes one or many actions. The action templates retain their line order, but TO, BODY, and example-label distinctions are unavailable. Hello is approximated by good addressed to the recipient. Company location and membership are only approximated, not fully expressed.
